summary.name: AI Gist
summary.one_liner: A free, open-source, local-first prompt manager for saving, filling in, and copying reusable AI prompts on your own device.
use_cases: Store and organise a personal library of AI prompts
Fill variables in reusable prompt templates
Refine or generate prompts with a local model
Keep prompts private on your own device
Back up and restore a prompt collection
summary.what_it_does: AI Gist lets you save prompts as cards, in a table, or in folders, and narrow them with categories, tags, favourites and search. It recognises variables and Jinja templates in a prompt, turns them into input fields, and shows the rendered result so you can copy it. It can connect to Ollama, LM Studio or a service you configure to generate or rewrite prompts, and it records each time a template is used. Data stays on the current device by default, with WebDAV and iCloud sync available only when enabled, plus full export and import.
notable: Local-first storage with encrypted local backups and manifest
Jinja2 template variables with live rendered preview
Connects to Ollama or LM Studio for prompt generation and refinement
caveats: AI generation requires connecting a model such as Ollama or LM Studio or a service you configure yourself
Sync is off by default and only works when turned on
Desktop app is suited to organising and maintaining; phone and tablet suited to finding, filling and copying
